theme: Error reporting: non-fatal errors, breadcrumbs and crash-free rate

terms.definition: An error that your app catches and reports, while the app keeps running.
terms.example: Report every non-fatal error with context.

terms.definition: A short note about a user step, saved before an error, so you can see what led to it.
terms.example: Add a breadcrumb for each screen the user opens.
terms.code:
var crumbs: [String] = []
crumbs.append("open cart")
crumbs.append("tap pay")
print(crumbs.joined(separator: " > "))

terms.definition: The share of users or sessions that did not hit a crash, shown as a percentage.
terms.example: Our crash-free rate is ninety-nine percent.
terms.code:
let sessions = 1000.0
let crashes = 5.0
print((sessions - crashes) / sessions * 100)

video.title: Non-Fatal Error, Breadcrumb & Crash-Free Rate | Day 241
video.description:
Learn to explain how teams find problems that do not crash the app: Non-Fatal Error, Breadcrumb & Crash-Free Rate, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Non-Fatal Error - An error that your app catches and reports, while the app keeps running.
Breadcrumb - A short note about a user step, saved before an error, so you can see what led to it.
Crash-Free Rate - The share of users or sessions that did not hit a crash, shown as a percentage.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: iOS Non-Fatal Error, Breadcrumb & Crash-Free Rate | Day 241
landscape.description:
Explain Non-Fatal Error, Breadcrumb & Crash-Free Rate in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Non-Fatal Error, Breadcrumb, Crash-Free Rate 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Non-Fatal Error - An error that your app catches and reports, while the app keeps running.
한국어: Non-Fatal Error: 앱이 잡아서 보고하고 계속 실행되는 오류

Breadcrumb - A short note about a user step, saved before an error, so you can see what led to it.
한국어: Breadcrumb: 오류가 나기 전에 남겨 두어 무엇이 원인이었는지 알 수 있게 하는 사용자 행동 메모

Crash-Free Rate - The share of users or sessions that did not hit a crash, shown as a percentage.
한국어: Crash-Free Rate: 충돌을 겪지 않은 사용자나 세션의 비율을 퍼센트로 나타낸 값

landscape.hook: Can you explain Non-Fatal Error, Breadcrumb and Crash-Free Rate in English?

dialogue.title: The silent payment bug
dialogue.setting: Users cannot pay, but there is no crash

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the dashboard shows no crash, but users cannot pay. Why?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The app did not crash. It was a non-fatal error, so the app kept running.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do we report a non-fatal error too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. In the `catch` block, send it to the error tool.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: But the report only says declined. I want more context.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add breadcrumbs. A breadcrumb is a short note about a user step.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Like `crumbs` with open cart, then tap pay?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. The last breadcrumb before the error shows what led to it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do we know the app is healthy overall?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Watch the crash-free rate. It is the share of users that did not hit a crash.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So a 99.5 percent crash-free rate is good?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It is okay, but track each non-fatal error too. The crash-free rate hides them.
Report every non-fatal error with context.
